evaluation: human-in-the-loop; expected findings are labels, not automatic reasoning scores

findings.required_reasoning: A, B, C overlap on one machine; schedule is infeasible and must be BLOCKED.

anchor.quote: The genetic algorithm is the mathematical model

findings.required_reasoning: An algorithm name does not specify decision variables, objective and constraint equations.
A heuristic run with no certificate/gap cannot prove global optimality, and the candidate is infeasible.
Paper claims a genetic algorithm (100 population, 200 generations); code dispatches jobs greedily at release.
Weighted sum differs from requested and claimed lexicographic objective; equivalence is not proved.

false_positive_guards: Do not invent unobserved numerical instability, data deletion or fabricated citations.
Do not flag synthetic data as misconduct; it is explicitly labeled.
A single root cause should not be inflated into multiple false critical findings.
